# discord_audit_log (Data Source)

Reads entries from a Discord guild's audit log. Requires the `VIEW_AUDIT_LOG` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_audit_log" "recent_bans" {
  guild_id    = "123456789012345678"
  action_type = 22 # MEMBER_BAN_ADD
  limit       = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild.

### Optional

- `action_type` (Number) Filter entries to this audit log action type.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entries to return (1-100).
- `user_id` (String) Filter entries to those performed by this user ID.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) The matching audit log entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action_type` (Number) The audit log action type.
- `id` (String) Entry snowflake ID.
- `reason` (String) The reason supplied for the action, if any.
- `target_id` (String) ID of the affected entity.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user who performed the action.
